about_the_game:
[Game Overview]

Explore a world sunk in fog and darkness, and run from monsters that hunt you.
Solve puzzles using clues hidden in the environment, open new paths, and escape this world.

This is an exploration horror puzzle with very little guidance. Observe, experiment, and find your way.
Playtime: 20 min ~35 mi

[Key Features]

Psychological Horror + Chase: If you’re spotted, the chase begins. Hold your breath and survive.

Exploration & Puzzles: Search abandoned spaces, gather clues, and solve puzzles to progress.

Choices & Consequences: Your choices cannot be undone, and they become your story alone.

Rules of an Unfamiliar World: You must understand a world where familiar standards don’t apply.

[Lore]

In a world with an order of its own, you may be an outsider no one can truly understand.
To escape this world, you must pay an appropriate “price.”
Your choices become your only “history,” and the one and only “precedent” in this world.

Welcome to a new world without human emotions or standards.

You have been left alone in an abandoned world.
A world without human language, writing—perhaps even without death.
Only those who enter can learn it through their own judgment and choices.

Who are they?

You are not alone here.
Those who refuse to be understood, and the sorrow of those who arrived first, remain as traces in this world.
This world may be sad. Hold your breath, try to understand them, and sometimes walk with them—

Create a “precedent” called [Understanding]—something only you can create.

Life and behavior in this world are not bound by human common sense.
That is why every choice you make while learning this world carries a price—and it is yours alone to bear.
Your choices cannot be undone, and your unique story will be recorded in this world.

[Achievements (Challenges) Notice]

This game intentionally does not provide separate achievements (challenges). Your experience is designed to remain as memory, not a checklist. Now, and in the time to come.

[Developer Content Description]

This game is a psychological horror that includes frequent depictions of blood, gore, and corpses (e.g., rivers of blood, walls covered in flesh). It contains intense psychological horror and chase sequences. It also includes story-related self-harm content (finger amputation), implied rather than explicitly shown.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a psychological horror that includes frequent depictions of blood, gore (such as rivers of blood, walls of flesh), and corpses. It contains scenes of intense psychological terror and chase sequences. There is also a plot-related scene involving self-harm (a finger amputation), which is implied rather than explicitly shown.
